title: NASA composite micromechanics equations and constituent data bank (Chamis; ICAN)

NASA-TM-83320.citation: Chamis, C. C.: Simplified Composite Micromechanics Equations for Hygral, Thermal and Mechanical Properties. NASA TM-83320, NASA Lewis Research Center, 1983.

NASA-TP-2515.citation: Murthy, P. L. N.; Chamis, C. C.: Integrated Composite Analyzer (ICAN) Users and Programmers Manual. NASA TP-2515, 1986.

NASA-TP-3290.citation: Murthy, P. L. N.; Ginty, C. A.; Sanfeliz, J. G.: Second Generation Integrated Composite Analyzer (ICAN) Computer Code. NASA TP-3290, 1993.

reuse.basis: NTRS record metadata for all three: distribution PUBLIC; copyright determination GOV_PUBLIC_USE_PERMITTED (U.S. Government works, NASA Lewis Research Center). TP-3290 report documentation page: 'Unclassified - Unlimited'.

files.note: cited pages only: the PDFs' embedded OCR text layer, extracted with pypdf 6.19.0 (PdfReader.extract_text), unmodified

used: Micromechanics equations (TM-83320 figs. 5-6; TP-3290 appendix D) implemented in domains/uav_materials/micromechanics.py. Constituent values for AS graphite fibre and IMLS epoxy matrix, each accepted only when OCR renderings in at least two of the three documents agree (domains/uav_materials/constituents.py).
not_used: TM-83320 Table 1 (fibre properties): its page has no text layer, and values are not transcribed by hand. The TM-83320 Table 2 matrix-modulus row (ambiguous columns). Hygral, thermal and hygrothermal equations. All other fibres and matrices.
caveats: TM-83320: constituent tables 'were compiled from many sources and many values are estimates which were inferred from predicted results and curve fits'; and 'No comparisons were provided between predicted values and available measured data'. Values are indicative, not lot-specific design data.
